tara: Quick heads-up: BlueHaven LoRA merge (v4a+lora-bluehaven) + int3 quant on quickpack shows invoice extraction regressions. Strange date parsing drop.
mike: can you share a minimal repro and numbers?
tara: repro prompt: 'Extract invoice date from: Invoice #BH-334 on 03/04/2025 for $1,234.50'
results: int3 top_date_exact=0.28, baseline fp16 top_date_exact=0.94. overall NER F1 dropped from 0.91 -> 0.34.
leo: that's alarming. Date formats are sensitive to tokenization; did the adapter add any token embeddings for hyphens/slashes?
jun: int3 quant can cause small-norm collapse in rare tokens. i'll diff embedding norms for '/', '-', digits.
ci-bot: CI job 'bluehaven-quickpack-int3' failed: invoice_date_check (build 9017).
tara: latency improved (fp16 160ms -> int3 82ms) but can't tradeoff core extraction quality.
leo: try quick mitigations: (1) per-channel quant for embedding table, (2) keep fp16 for embedding layer, (3) small adapter-retrain focusing on date examples.
mike: can we test a tokenizer diff first to rule out token remap? share token ids for '03/04/2025'.
jun: token ids look the same, but L2 norms: fp16 digit tokens ~1.05, int3 ~0.04. looks like collapse.
tara: uploaded focused anchor set: gs://rwd-bluehaven/invoice-date-anchor.json
leo: plan: jun will run per-channel embed quant; i'll spin int4-last-layer fallback and mike will draft a 30m adapter retrain recipe. if rescale fixes, we can roll a hotfix.
oncall-bot: incident #CUST-BLUEHAVEN-DEGRA created (sev: medium) assigned eng-ml.
jun: per-channel embed run started; smoke snapshot ETA ~25m, will update.
mike: ok locking this thread for coordination. thanks all. :v:
